prompt.text:
Does the owner check keep the document private?

The document route's authorization policy, as the run recorded it:
(user, document) => document.owner === user

Why this change: the baseline returned Bob's private document to Alice (GET /documents/bob-private as alice: 200). Signing in alone did not enforce ownership.
Replace the baseline policy:
(_user, _document) => true
with the owner check above. Review the same Alice and Bob requests again: does it close the leak while preserving the owner's access?
